minihud.config.generic.comment.dateForma:
The format string for the Minecraft time.
The supported placeholders are: {DAY_1}, {DAY}, {HOUR}, {MIN}, {SEC}, {MINIRL}, {SECIRL}, {MOON}.
{DAY_1} starts the day counter from 1, {DAY} starts from 0.

The format string for real time, see the Java DateTimeFormatter
class Syntax for the format patterns, if needed.

The format real time using the selected formatter options:
Regular (§6Default§r): '§a2025-02-02_13.55.44§r' (§eyyyy-MM-dd_HH.mm.ss§r) 
ISO Local: '§a2025-02-02T13:55:44.0939044§r' (§eyyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.n§r)
ISO Offset: '§a2025-02-02T13:55:44.0939044-05:00§r' (§eyyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.nZ§r)
RFC1123: '§aSun, 2 Feb 2025 13:55:44 -0500§r' (§eEEE, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss +HHMM§r) 
Formatted: This option uses the "§bdateFormatString§r" as input.

minihud.config.generic.comment.entityDat:
Use the Entity Data Sync protocol from Servux
to obtain Entity Data from the server
This feature requires to have either "infoLinesUsesNbt" or "entityDataSyncLoadNbt" enabled

Use the Vanilla NBT Query method when Servux
is not available.  This method requires Operator Privileges.

Enable `§eentityDataSyncBackup§r` Open-To-Lan packet
handling override for other players

The Cache refresh value as a fraction of a second.
This value is the trigger for whenever requesting entity data
gets refreshed from the server, even if it still exists in the Cache.
This should be set around 1/4 or less of
the "entityDataSyncCacheTimeout" value.
A value of '0.05f' means 50 ms or once every game tick.

The Cache timeout value in seconds that
the Entity Cache keeps records for.
A lower value means more frequent Cache purges.
This should always be set higher than "entityDataSyncCacheRefresh"
or it could produce unexpected results.

Load the synced NBT data into the Client World.
§6WARNING!  This feature will cause incompatibility
§6with other mods that rely on this data.
